1.body:
Hi Chris,

I saw the Junior Product Designer listing on Jobgether and was immediately drawn to your team's focus on creating intuitive digital experiences for companies managing a global workforce.

Throughout my work as a UI/UX designer at AT Creation and a graphic designer at Ascent Business Solutions, I have conducted usability testing, developed reusable design systems, and delivered over 100 digital and print creatives while collaborating with stakeholders.

My B2B case study, Bounceless, demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, which you can review directly in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick look at that case study to see if my background fits your team?

Ananya
